cases.name: built-in worked example
stdout: (demo: nothing passing — add flags for what you do have, or --all)
BLOCKED — Content doesn't render without JavaScript. Fix that before anything else — the rest of the score is theoretical until an agent can read the page.
Why it matters: Agents that don't execute JS see an empty shell. This is the single hardest blocker — nothing else matters if the content isn't there.
Fix: Server-render or prerender every page an agent might read. Verify with view-source, not DevTools.
Why it matters: An agent comparing options cannot include you. 'Contact us' is a non-answer to a machine — it will return your competitor's number instead.
Fix: Publish prices as text, not images, with the unit and currency explicit.
Why it matters: Without schema, an agent has to infer what your page is from prose.
Fix: Add Product, Service, Offer, Organization and FAQPage schema where each applies.
Why it matters: If every path requires a human conversation, an agent can't progress the purchase at all.
Fix: Offer at least one route — trial, purchase, or booking — that completes without a sales call.
Why it matters: Capabilities buried in marketing prose can't be matched against requirements.
Fix: Tables or lists with consistent labels. Say what it does, not how transformative it is.
Why it matters: Agents build comparisons whether or not you supply the facts. Absent yours, they use a competitor's framing.
Fix: Publish honest comparison pages, integration lists, and limits — including what you don't do.
Why it matters: No programmatic surface means no agent-initiated action.
Fix: Document a public API, or at minimum a stable booking or enquiry endpoint.
Why it matters: CAPTCHA on enquiry or signup blocks legitimate agents alongside bots.
Fix: Use invisible or risk-based challenges; keep at least one unblocked path.
WHAT AN AGENT CAN DO TODAY
Read your content      NO — this is the blocker
Compare you on price   no — you're excluded from price comparisons
Take an action         no — every path needs a human
Reach you at all       no — crawlers are blocked
This is a self-assessment. Verify each answer against the live site —
view-source for rendering, robots.txt for access, and an actual agent

"fix": "Publish prices as text, not images, with the unit and currency explicit."
"fix": "Add Product, Service, Offer, Organization and FAQPage schema where each applies."
"fix": "Offer at least one route — trial, purchase, or booking — that completes without a sales call."
"fix": "Tables or lists with consistent labels. Say what it does, not how transformative it is."
"fix": "Publish honest comparison pages, integration lists, and limits — including what you don't do."
"fix": "Document a public API, or at minimum a stable booking or enquiry endpoint."
"fix": "Use invisible or risk-based challenges; keep at least one unblocked path."
"fix": "Organization schema with the same legal name, URL and contact everywhere."
"fix": "Decide deliberately per crawler. Blocking training crawlers is defensible; blocking retrieval crawlers costs you visibility."
"fix": "Publish llms.txt listing your key pages, what each covers, and the canonical facts."
"fix": "Attribute every statistic. Prefer specific, checkable facts over superlatives."
"fix": "One number for one fact, everywhere. Audit for drift periodically."
"fix": "Allowlist known retrieval agents; rate-limit rather than block outright."
"fix": "One H1, meaningful H2s, no heading levels skipped for visual effect."
